InboxReport.description:
Result of `speccoder inbox`: every decision that waits for a
person, across the project's features, the most urgent first — the
person's work once the agents write the code.

kind.description:
What kind, in the order of urgency: `unknown` (the calls waiting in
the feature's journal could not be read — some may wait for you),
`approval` (a run waits on it),
`ruling` (a verified attempt is held: its tests reject an
alternative the spec allows), `gaming` (the monitor suspects a
shortcut), `stale` (proven against an earlier wording), `question`
(the spec leaves questions open), `review`
(requirements not approved on their current wording), `revise`
(changes requested on the spec), `stuck` (the
last attempt did not pass), `aside` (changes a run set aside),
`commit` (planning files a run cannot
read yet), `handoff` (every task done: review and hand it off) —
and a bug's `bug_confirm`, `bug_cannot_reproduce`,
`bug_unchanged_not_holding`, `bug_repro_weak`,
`bug_already_satisfied` (the registry: `speccoder_core::inbox::Kind`).

comments.description: The comments it was sent with.

outside.description: Of those, the ones no comment touched.

asked_again.description: Requirements whose tests were asked again from test comments.

beside.description:
Documents changed while it ran by something other than the skill
(the person's own edit): *Undo Revision* never overwrites them.

diffs.description:
While it waits to be kept or undone: each changed section, before
and after, for the word diff.

SectionDiff.description:
One section a revision changed, before and after (each cut to 4000
characters).

heading.description: Its heading path (`Spec › Requirements`; empty before the first).

before.description: The section's text before the revision (empty: it was added).

command.description: The Spec Kit command, as run (or to be confirmed).

output.description: Spec Kit's own output (its last lines).

state.description: The preset as Spec Kit reports it.

PresetState.description: The speccoder preset in a project, as Spec Kit reports it.

results.description: Each step's outcome (empty on a dry run).

first_feature.description: The project's first feature, prefilled from the idea.

mode.description: A new folder or an existing repository.

stacks.description: Every stack and whether its tool is installed.

formats.description: Every format and whether its tool is installed.

preset.description: Whether the speccoder Spec Kit preset is passed to the format's init.

digest.description: SHA-256 over all of the above.

oneOf.description: A folder that does not exist yet, or an empty one.
A git repository at its top level with a clean tree and no spec project.

detected.description: Found in an existing repository rather than chosen.

reason.description: Why it was suggested or detected.

StackOption.description: A stack's tool on this machine.

disabled.description: Why it cannot be chosen (its tool is missing), with the install hint.

FormatOption.description: A spec format the plan can initialise, and its tool's state.

ExtensionChoice.description: A Spec Kit extension the person chose.

source.description: A bundled name, a local path or a URL, as given.

oneOf.description: Bundled with the format's tool (`bug`).
A local directory.
Downloaded: a network step.

argv.description: The command, exactly as it runs.

cwd.description: Where it runs: always the target.

hosts.description:
The hosts a network step is expected to reach: shown, not enforced —
the step gets the full network.

writes.description: What it writes, in one line.

note.description: A note the plan shows beside it.

StepAccess.description: Whether a step stays on the machine.

oneOf.description: No network.
It gets the full network (the hosts it names are expected, not enforced).

SandboxNote.description: The OS sandbox the steps run in.

PlanRefusal.description: Why the plan cannot run, and the fix.

ObservedFolder.description: The folder and the tools as the plan saw them.

head.description: `HEAD`, in a repository with a commit.

tools.description: Each tool's version line, by name.

exit.description: Its exit status, when it ran.

output_tail.description: The last lines of its output (at most 20).

PlanStepState.description: A step's state in a run.

oneOf.description: Not started.
Running now.
Finished.
Its effect was already there (resume).
Failed; later steps did not run.

SampleReport.description:
Result of `speccoder sample`: where the copy is and whether its
recorded runs replay strictly with this build.

path.description: The copy, in speccoder's state directory.

fresh.description: A fresh copy was made (else an existing one was reopened).

model.description: The model it was recorded with.

agentplane.description: The agentplane version that recorded it.

SampleRun.description: One recorded run of the sample, replayed.

finding.description: What differed, when it did not reproduce.

SimilarReport.description: The `similar` payload: what was compared and what is close.

compared.description: How many requirements it was compared with.

limited.description:
Whether the corpus was limited to the [`MAX_UNITS`] most recently
changed units.

matches.description: The close ones, the closest first.

SimilarMatch.description: A requirement close to the description.

score.description: Cosine in [0, 1], rounded to two places.

shared.description: The terms it shares with the description, the weightiest first.

oneOf.description: At or above [`CLOSE`].
At or above [`VERY_CLOSE`].

RungSuggestion.description:
The composer's suggestion for a text (`rung_suggestion`): computed by
code from the text alone, shown with its reason, never applied without
the person's key or click.

available.description: Whether this build has it (`false` for `ask` until the Ask panel).

alternatives.description: The other rungs, in the composer's order.

command.description: The command that takes the suggested rung (none for `ask` and `none`).

RungPick.description:
A rung the composer can open for a description: a bug fix, a quick
change, a feature, or a question (`ask`); `none` only for an empty text.

oneOf.description: A wrong result of existing behaviour (`speccoder bug`).
One requirement, judged like a task (`speccoder do`).
A spec the format's skill writes (`speccoder spec specify`).
A question: a read-only answer.
Nothing to suggest: the text is empty.

RungCue.description:
What decided a suggestion: the rule and the words of the text that met
it, verbatim.

RungCueRule.description: The rule that decided a suggestion.

oneOf.description: An interrogative first word or a trailing `?`.
A word for a wrong result of existing behaviour.
Two or more capabilities joined.
More than [`LONG_WORDS`] words.
None of the above.

PlanningChainReport.description:
Result of `speccoder spec <skill> --through <t>`: the skills it ran,
where it stopped, and the unit's readiness. Plan through keeps no
state of its own: the stop is read again from the unit's files.

unit.description: The unit (once the creating skill made it).

through.description: How far it was asked to go.

ran.description: The skills it ran, in order.

similar.description: Requirements of other units close to the description (a hint).

next_skill.description: The skill a continuation runs next.

run_id.description: Its agentplane run, when it ran.

ChainStop.description:
Where plan through stopped: only where a person decides, at a
failure, or at the end.

oneOf.description: The spec leaves questions open: answer them first.
Review the spec: planning waits for the requirements' approval.

requirements.description: The requirements to approve, by id.

oneOf.description: A skill failed or was refused; what ran before it is kept.
Done through the chosen step.

plan_checks.description: The plan checks of the task list, when one was written.

PlanCheck.description: A plan check of the new task list (`PLAN-*`): a warning, never a stop.
